prompt: Implement Conway's Game of Life step. `pub struct Life { pub w: usize, pub h: usize, pub cells: Vec<bool> }` with `pub fn new(w: usize, h: usize) -> Self` (all dead), `pub fn set(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, alive: bool)`, `pub fn get(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> bool`, `pub fn step(&mut self)` applying Conway's rules (a live cell with 2 or 3 live neighbours survives; a dead cell with exactly 3 live neighbours becomes live; all others die — 8-neighbourhood, edges are dead), and `pub fn population(&self) -> usize`.
